definitions.hash: Keccak round_update or SHA256 round/feed-forward; attribution priority.
definitions.profile_active: Symbolic core.IDLE/core.FAILED exclusion matching core.cycles; FINISH included.
definitions.hash_template_nonhash: Accepted explicit HASH command through sampled command_done inclusive, excluding Hash.
definitions.recipe_nonhash: Accepted scalar request through consumed response inclusive, excluding Hash; subset of template clocks.
definitions.control_fetch: Sequencer FETCH opcode from current program_data, not stale token.
definitions.joint_histogram: Remaining clocks only, sampled before positive clock edge. State IDs diagnostic; categories use enum-based semantic predicates.

decisions.i_prefetch: Rejected: both backends fail100MHz; live FORS bypass retains long path.
decisions.i_software: Adopted: all byte/work/complete-operation tests pass; both100MHz routes legal, positive setup/hold; Remaining below SLOTH for both.
decisions.i_timing_v3: Not selected: both100MHz routes pass and selected KAT passes, but routed-area x KAT-cycle product worse by ~1.6%/1.8%; remaining complete validation continues in background.
decisions.c_control_pipeline: Adopted: smallest routed common area among closed100MHz candidates on both backends; full validation passes; 128f cycle cost ~4.5% SHAKE/~1.8% SHA2 disclosed.
decisions.c_selective_pipeline: Not selected: less cycle overhead but routed common area higher, unfavorable area/cycle tradeoff across the three focus Sign jobs.
